effects: Records one final vote (For or Against) from the signer on the proposal; the signer cannot vote again on it (GovernorVotes._storeVote sets hasVoted).
The vote's weight is all of the signer's governance vote power at the proposal's snapshot block, read from storage (Governor._castVote: governanceVotePower.votePowerOfAt).
No tokens or native value move. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "cast vote", with the proposal id as a raw number and Support shown as For/Against through an enum that matches the contract's VoteType.

findings.title: castVote: the vote weight and the fact that the vote is final are not shown
findings.evidence: Governor._castVote: votePower = governanceVotePower.votePowerOfAt(_voter, proposal.votePowerBlock); GovernorVotes._storeVote: require(!_voting.hasVoted[_voter]). Neither value is in the calldata.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A label or intent such as 'Cast final vote' could mention that the vote cannot be changed.

findings.title: castVote: the proposal id is a keccak hash that the signer cannot match to a proposal
findings.evidence: GovernorProposals._getProposalId returns uint256(keccak256(abi.encode(chainId, address(this), ...))). The descriptor shows '#._proposalId' as raw, so the signer sees a 77-digit number. Cases 0 and 1 use id 7, which no real proposal has.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. Use a realistic hash-sized proposal id in the tests.

findings.title: castVote has no interpolatedIntent naming the side and the proposal
findings.evidence: descriptor castVote: intent 'cast vote', no interpolatedIntent.

formats.key: propose(address[] _targets, uint256[] _values, bytes[] _calldatas, string _description, (bool accept, uint256 votingStartTs, uint256 votingPeriodSeconds, uint256 vpBlockPeriodSeconds, uint256 thresholdConditionBIPS, uint256 majorityConditionBIPS, uint256 executionDelaySeconds, uint256 executionPeriodSeconds) _settings)
effects: Creates an executable proposal with the signer as proposer. Only the signer can later cancel it before voting or execute it (Governor.cancel and Governor._execute check proposal.proposer == msg.sender).

Commits the on-chain actions: calls to _targets with _calldatas and native _values, run from the PollingFoundation contract. When the signer later executes, they must send msg.value equal to the sum of _values (GovernorProposals._executeProposal).

Sets the voting rules: accept/reject type, voting start = max(now, votingStartTs), voting period, threshold and majority in BIPS. The vote-power snapshot block is chosen at random within a lookback of vpBlockPeriodSeconds.

Sets an execution window that starts at voteEnd + executionDelaySeconds, or later if an earlier proposal's window pushes it back (nextExecutionStartTime). Moves the global nextExecutionStartTime forward.
No tokens or native value move in this call. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "create proposal", then target, native value and raw calldata for each action, the description, and the settings (accept flag, start date, durations, bps thresholds).

findings.title: propose (executable): the proposal's action calldata is shown as raw hex
findings.evidence: descriptor field 'Calldatas' format 'raw' path '#._calldatas.[]'. Case 2 shows '0x12345678'. GovernorProposals._executeProposal later runs _targets[i].call{value: _values[i]}(_calldatas[i]).
findings.fix: Use format 'calldata' with calleePath '#._targets.[]' and amountPath '#._values.[]' so wallets can decode each action. Otherwise state in the label that these are the encoded calls the proposal will run.

findings.title: propose (executable): 'Values' does not say the proposer must pay this native value at execution
findings.evidence: GovernorProposals._executeProposal: require(msg.value == sum, ...). Only the proposer can execute (Governor._execute). The descriptor labels it 'Values' (case 2: '1 SGB').
findings.fix: Relabel it, e.g. 'Native value sent with call (paid by you at execution)'.

findings.title: propose: the 'Accept if vote passes' raw boolean hides the reject-type semantics
findings.evidence: Governor._proposalSucceeded: with accept=false, the proposal succeeds when quorum is not met or Against is not a majority. The descriptor shows 'Accept if vote passes' in format raw (case 2: 'true').
findings.fix: Use an enum or label such as 'Proposal type': true = 'Accept (needs FOR majority)', false = 'Reject (passes unless voted down)'.

findings.title: propose: the execution delay is a minimum and the 'Vp Block Period' label is jargon
findings.evidence: GovernorProposals._storeProposal: if (proposal.execStartTime < nextExecutionStartTime) proposal.execStartTime = nextExecutionStartTime. Governor._calculateVotePowerBlock picks a random block within the lookback. Labels 'Execution Delay' and 'Vp Block Period'.
findings.fix: Relabel to 'Minimum execution delay' and 'Vote-power snapshot lookback'.

findings.title: propose (executable): the intent does not say the signer becomes the proposer who must execute it
findings.evidence: intent 'create proposal', no interpolatedIntent. Governor._execute: require(proposal.proposer == msg.sender).
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Create executable proposal: {_description}'.

formats.key: propose(string _description, (bool accept, uint256 votingStartTs, uint256 votingPeriodSeconds, uint256 vpBlockPeriodSeconds, uint256 thresholdConditionBIPS, uint256 majorityConditionBIPS) _settings)
effects: Creates a non-executable (signalling) proposal with the signer as proposer. Only the signer can cancel it before voting starts.

Sets the voting rules: accept/reject type, voting start = max(now, votingStartTs), voting period, vote-power snapshot lookback, threshold and majority in BIPS. Execution parameters are fixed at delay 0 and period 1, and there are no targets.
No tokens or native value move. The function is not payable.
formats.shown: "create proposal", with the description and the settings (accept flag, start date, durations, bps thresholds).

findings.title: propose (signal): the 'Accept if vote passes' raw boolean hides the reject-type semantics
findings.evidence: Governor._proposalSucceeded: with accept=false, the proposal succeeds unless quorum is met and Against has the majority. The descriptor shows 'Accept if vote passes' in format raw (case 3: 'true').
findings.fix: Use an enum or label such as 'Proposal type': Accept (needs FOR majority) / Reject (passes unless voted down).

findings.title: propose (signal): 'Vp Block Period' is jargon and the intent does not say it is a non-executable poll
findings.evidence: PollingFoundation.propose(string,...) calls _propose with empty targets. The descriptor has intent 'create proposal' and label 'Vp Block Period'.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Create poll (no on-chain actions)' and relabel to 'Vote-power snapshot lookback'.
